strapiBlog.title: Dubai's Trump Tower to Feature World's Highest Outdoor Pool
strapiBlog.short_description: Dubai's skyline is about to soar to spectacular new heights with the unveiling of the Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai.

data.text:
Dubai's skyline is about to soar to spectacular new heights with the unveiling of the Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai. Standing tall as an 80-story architectural masterpiece, this luxury skyscraper Dubai is set to become the epitome of elegance and grandeur. Among its many extraordinary features, the standout is undoubtedly the world's highest outdoor pool.

Perched impressively above the bustling cityscape, this stunning pool offers swimmers unmatched views of iconic landmarks, including the majestic Burj Khalifa. Whether enjoying a sunrise swim or an evening dip beneath the stars, residents and guests will experience sheer luxury from this breathtaking vantage point.

A Partnership of Prestige and Innovation

The Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai is brought to life through the prestigious Dar Global Trump partnership. This collaboration between the Trump Organization and luxury real estate developer Dar Global underscores their shared vision for innovation, excellence, and refined luxury.

This project is the fifth successful joint venture between these globally acclaimed entities, following renowned developments in Saudi Arabia and Oman.

Exclusive Residences and Luxurious Living

The Trump Tower Dubai will feature a sophisticated array of residential options, including one, two, and three-bedroom apartments alongside spectacular four-bedroom duplex penthouses.

Each penthouse is inspired by the iconic Trump Tower Penthouse in New York, showcasing private sky pools, floor-to-ceiling windows, and meticulously crafted interiors that promise panoramic city views and refined elegance.

data.text:
Opulent Amenities and State-of-the-Art Facilities

Beyond the spectacular world's highest outdoor pool, Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai will offer an array of exceptional amenities designed for ultimate luxury and convenience. The tower houses a five-star hotel, premium private residences, and an exclusive members-only club aptly named "The Trump."

Residents and guests will benefit from world-class facilities including a resort-style pool, state-of-the-art fitness center, private lounges, personalized concierge services, sophisticated entertainment spaces, and a dedicated children’s play area. Each aspect of the amenities is thoughtfully designed to provide a seamless blend of luxury and comfort.

faqs.question: Can all guests access the world's highest outdoor pool?

data.answer: Yes, this iconic feature is accessible to both residents and hotel guests, providing an extraordinary swimming experience.

faqs.question: When will the tower be completed?

data.answer: Trump Tower Dubai is scheduled for completion in 2031.

Where is the location of Trump Tower?

data.answer: It is located on Sheikh Zayed Road.
